object.description: Make write tool calls that name a missing object, attribute or view, or give a value that the tool or the document's attribute definitions refuse. The calls give: an undeclared attribute, a value that isn't an option, a link to a document that isn't a parent, the same link twice and a link to a missing object in one call, a missing object, an undeclared attribute to make required, document IDs with a slash, a space, a dot or nothing, a figure that isn't SVG, a figure for a missing object, a table whose cells don't fill its columns, a blank view name, a missing view to rename, delete or edit, and deleting an object that has children.
